title: Unrelated failures in the same ten minutes
purpose: Restraint. Five real problems arrive close together, but each is about something different. Failures alone are not an incident; they have to describe the same thing.

tickets.body: The OTP to log in never arrives on my phone.
My parcel was supposed to arrive yesterday and tracking hasn't moved.
The refund for my returned headphones still isn't credited after 10 days.
The app crashes every time I open my orders page.
I received a blue shirt instead of the black one I ordered.
